doc: Every counter of the Japanese counters table (server/internal/counters/table/counters-ja.json) with each asked number's prompt, kanji form, readings (canonical first, then the accepted ones) and common mistakes (README, "Readings"); also the answer of GET /api/drills/counters. Generated by the Go test with UPDATE_COUNTERS_FIXTURE=1 and reviewed by hand and by teacher agents (table/REVIEW.md). Go: server/internal/counters/readings_test.go; web: apps/web/src/lib/features/practice/counters/check.test.ts, words.test.ts.

counters.counts: things in general, including abstract ones like questions and ideas, when no specific counter fits (one to nine; ask with いくつ)
small, compact things: apples, eggs, sweets, erasers
people
long, thin things: pens, umbrellas, trees, bottles (also bottled and canned drinks); also films and TV dramas
flat, thin things: paper, plates, shirts, stamps, tickets, photos
books and other bound things: books, magazines, notebooks, dictionaries
most animals: pets, fish, insects (large animals use 頭, birds use 羽)
large animals, bigger than a person: horses, cows, elephants, bears
birds (and, traditionally, rabbits)
machines and vehicles: cars, bicycles, computers, televisions
cupfuls, glassfuls and bowlfuls: coffee, water, rice (the contents, not the cup itself, which is 個)
houses and shops
garments: suits, dresses, coats, kimono (in shops also shirts and sweaters)
pairs of shoes, socks, boots and slippers
letters, postcards and e-mails
cases and items: e-mails, messages, bookings, incidents
songs and pieces of music
times (how many times)
floors of a building (1階 is the ground floor)
numbers in a sequence: No. 1, No. 2 … (いちばん also means "the most")
times (like 回) and degrees: temperature, angles
age in years
the time: o'clock
minutes
hours (how long)
dates: the Nth day of the month (the 1st, the 2nd …)
the months of the year (January, February …)
months (how long)
weeks (how long)
nights' stay at a hotel or inn
years: the year (2026年) and how many years
yen (money)
